**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)**

- **What the document says:** Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority/enforceability/non-conflict representations plus a Globix Agreement carve-out. Section 1 imposes development, hosting and maintenance duties on HDI, and Section 1.6 sets a go-live deadline, but nothing warrants the quality or conformance of HDI's work or provides a remedy for defective work.
- **Why it fails:** No express performance warranty, no warranty period, no repair/re-perform/refund remedy — below even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services). Mitigating point: there is no "AS IS" disclaimer, so this is not walk-away territory, and Section 10.7 already survives Section 9 for two years.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new Section 9(c) adding workmanlike performance, a 90-day Site conformance warranty tied to the Section 5.2 acceptance, no-malicious-code and legal-compliance warranties, with re-performance/repair/refund as the remedy; comment offers the shorter-period fallback.
